test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, “ALBUM’ is written as 'CPHCW' and 'BOARD' is written as ‘DSGZN’. How will "CLEAR' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value of alphabet series is;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**ALBUM is written as CPHCW →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64db2b5d64610db321d6a9e6ea85e5b567bc077c6dc3c97b99509cbf416d453e.png] 

**BOARD' is written as DSGZN →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/867547542efd0573d3a7e023b3c746411883791b9b9bde80a49cd9241f39abd4.png] 

Similarly, 

**CLEAR be written as EPKIB →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73c2fa074b81422be038de9b438fc8593ac7deb092faf3b2ecbd7b8f9b1e11bd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"EPKIB **".
